_doc: Codex deterministic lifecycle hooks. Schema: https://developers.openai.com/codex/hooks (events: SessionStart, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop). Codex requires you to review and TRUST this file's hash before the command hooks run (see docs/OPERATOR_ENABLEMENT.md). Commands resolve the repo root via git so they work when Codex is launched from a subdirectory. PreToolUse exit code 2 blocks the tool call.
_note_lint: Per-edit lint-on-write is intentionally NOT wired for Codex: Codex edits arrive via apply_patch, not a file_path the linter can read. Run `./manage.sh check` to lint changed files under Codex. lint-on-write is Claude-only (see CHANGES_V3 support matrix).
